headline: Polished reports save as Word documents now — no more loose markdown files for things you read.

items.prompt_template: Every polished report I produce — automation scans, dormancy reports, audits, monthly recaps, follow-up packs, summaries — now saves as a Word document so it renders correctly in Word and Pages. Email drafts no longer save as files at all; they go straight to your Gmail Drafts. Files I use as working memory (briefings, insights, notes, project context) stay in their original format since they're for me to read, not you. No action needed — next time any of these fires, you get the document.
